Name: PFM Indoor Apiary - Indoor Bee House Mod
Author: FallUpFallInFallOut
Description:
This is a Producer Framework Mod that allows bee houses to produce honey indoors from either potted plants or the ground.

It works in sheds, barns, coops, your home, greenhouses, the sewer or where-ever else you could think to place a potted flower and beehive. You don't even need the flower if you want simple Wild Honey.

Simply extract your download and place [PFM] Indoor Apiary into your Stardew Valley/mods folder.
